description: Architecture Video — a short explainer video of the documented architecture, narrated by Alia on screen: what the system is, who it talks to, how it is organized in layers, each use case phase by phase with its budget, the decisions in force and the debt it declares open. Motion graphics built by code from the documents (no 3D, no recording) in the Alia Guide look, rendered to MP4 with HyperFrames. Use for "architecture video", "video de la arquitectura", "explainer video", "video explicativo", "make a video of the architecture", "onboarding video", or any request to explain the architecture as a video. Requires ARCHITECTURE.md. Not for the interactive 3D model (architecture-command-center) or Word exports.
